en: I never expected to have this much fun.

Thanks... Because of you, I forgot about
work and the other negative things.
Let's go back to the dorms.
...That was a good way to pass the time.
When I'm with you...time just flies by.
Want to head back to the dorms?

I'm not that good at spending time
with someone...

I thought I would be able to forget all my
bad memories if I spent time with you...
